notes: Fixes the crash some boards hit a few seconds after starting up, most often right after flashing or a USB reset.
Plugged into your phone over USB, the board now runs on USB only and turns Bluetooth off. Bluetooth comes back when you unplug.
Biscuit Crumb support: the LED ring glows with the battery level when idle, plays a rainbow when a phone connects, and flashes the app's alerts like police, trackers and drones.
Rabbit Labs Poltergeist support: the screen shows live APs, channels and link status, and flashes the app's alerts.
Every phone nearby now sees every board, who it's linked to, and its mode, temperature and AP count.
A board in use on another phone shows as taken instead of failing to connect.
Fixes a rare crash when a phone connects the moment a board powers on.
New terminal commands: link shows what the board is connected to, and drop disconnects it so another phone can link.
Removed the status LED setting. It never worked on most boards.
Scans every channel the board can tune: 2.4 GHz 1–14 and 5 GHz 36–177.
Fixes ESP32-S3 boards restarting every few seconds right after linking.
If a board ever crashes, Wardrive Go’s Diagnostics now shows why.
GPS: a board with a UART GPS receiver streams its position to Wardrive Go when the phone's own fix is stale or unavailable.
The startup report now records the last boot's progress correctly.
Bluetooth mode: with two or more boards linked, tap MAKE BT on one and it scans Bluetooth instead of Wi-Fi. The other boards keep Wi-Fi and share the channels.
Bluetooth devices are reported with their real addresses, so they count when you upload.
New terminal command: bt on / bt off.
Boot report: on every connect the board tells the app its firmware, slot, last reset reason and whether an update was rolled back.
If freshly updated firmware doesn't start within 30 seconds, the board restarts and goes back to the previous version on its own.
info also shows the boot report.
Terminal commands in Wardrive Go: help, info, status, ch, led, reboot. Unknown commands show the list.
led off keeps the status light dark, and the setting survives reboots.
Installs over Bluetooth on boards already running 1.2.
Firmware updates install over Bluetooth from Wardrive Go â€” one tap, no computer.
New flash layout: boards on 1.1.1 or older need one USB flash to reach 1.2. After that, updates come over Bluetooth.
If a new version fails to start, the board rolls back to the previous one.
The terminal's AP count shows the APs heard in each sweep.
ESP32-C5 scans 5 GHz (channels 36â€“48 and 149â€“161) as well as 2.4 GHz.
Several boards can link at once; the app splits the channels between them.
Each board has its own name.
First release: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi scanning streamed to Wardrive Go over Bluetooth.
